messages:
Claire (PM): Quick sync: two enterprise customers need an upgrade path that keeps their public footprint identical and supports tiny airgapped bundles. We need acceptance criteria + field runbook.
Ben (Eng): Tech plan: produce signed delta bundles (manifest + patches + migrations) and a migration runner with dry-run and resume. Reversible migrations are must-have.
Marta (Infra): Networking: we'll guarantee LB VIP and NAT egress ranges only. Pod IPs are not preserved. Add installer flag `--preserve-egress` and a preflight that returns PASS/FAIL.
Eli (Field): NetOps asks: single PASS/FAIL preflight, explicit remediation bullets, and an approval step. One-page timeline estimate needed for customers.
Noah (SRE): Rollback: cache previous bundle for 72h, record applied migration id, auto-revert on health-check failure unless customer opts out. Emit clear alerts with runbook link.
Claire (PM): MVP scope: signed delta spec + CLI verify/plan + preflight PASS/FAIL + 1-page NetOps runbook. Stretch: console preview + network-shadow simulator.
Ben (Eng): CLI examples:
`redwood delta verify ./bundle.tgz`
`redwood delta plan ./bundle.tgz --preserve-egress`
`redwood delta apply ./bundle.tgz --customer-approve`
Marta (Infra): Preflight JSON for gating, obfuscated IPs: `{"vip_ok":true,"egress_conflicts":[]}`.
Eli (Field): I'll line up two pilot customers and draft the runbook template.
deploy-bot: Ticket PRD-1607 created: "Airgap delta + egress-preserve upgrade path" (owner: Claire).
Noah (SRE): Add telemetry opt-in for upgrade events (success/failure/duration) to help tune SLOs.
Claire (PM): Action items: Ben -> manifest validator PR by Thu; Marta -> preflight prototype by Thu; Eli -> runbook draft by Mon; Noah -> rollback playbook by Fri. Sync next Tue 30m to lock acceptance. Thanks! :thumbsup:
